entities.summary: Subaru Shibutani (b. 1981-09-22, Ibaraki) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Ibaraki and Japan. Known in the fields of japan, composers & musicians, asia.
